# The I’M 50! Show

> A podcast about life at 50, made in Queensland, Australia, for listeners anywhere in the world, and hosted by Paul Burfitt. Each episode tackles a different topic, such as family, money, health, work, relationships, ageing parents, regrets and starting again, through solo episodes and honest conversations with guests. Formerly known as F*CK! I’M 50 (Fi50).

The show is published by 64 Brands (Cannonvale, Queensland, Australia). Episodes are audio-first and available on Apple Podcasts, Spotify, Amazon Music and Acast. Every episode page includes a full transcript.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://im50show.com/): what the show is and the latest episodes
- [What The?](https://im50show.com/what-the/): about the show and its host, Paul Burfitt
- [Podcast episodes](https://im50show.com/episodes/podcast/): every episode, with show notes and transcripts
- [Become a guest](https://im50show.com/guest/): how guest conversations work and how to book a recording
- [Contact](https://im50show.com/contact/): guest, general and commercial partnership enquiries
